subject: statistics: simplify FMSketch by removing swiss map and pool (#66590)
summary: Replaces FMSketch’s swiss-map + object pooling with a plain Go `map[uint64]struct{}` and removes the FMSketch pool lifecycle APIs; updates analyze/global-stats/json-dump paths to nil out FMSketch references for GC; drops the dolthub/swiss (and maphash) dependency and corresponding Bazel deps.
